newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends down, but direction unclear.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends down, but direction unclear.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly lower against its U.S. counterpart on Saturday, but dealers said its direction was unclear.
The local unit ended at T$27.859 against Friday's T$27.850 close. Turnover through dealers was a thin US$47 million.
Dealers noted some foreign fund inflows for the red-hot stock market, whose index closed up 66.06 points or 0.72 percent at 9,258.63, a seven-year high close.
"Some foreign funds flowed in, but some commercial U.S. dollar demand also emerged," said one dealer. "There is no clear direction for the Taiwan dollar at the moment."
For next week, a stable T$27.84-87 range was seen.
